workspace.text:
I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots where both are free next week (Nov 16-20):

- Monday: 09:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Please read Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots (or any other slots) work for both of them. We need a 30-minute window where all four partners are free.
